paras: Our Formula 1 heritage is evident in our AT-R3 swan neck wing. Its compositional design is 45% lighter than aluminium, while the upright engineering maximizes aerodynamic efficiency and minimizes air resistance.
ADRO's BMW M2 AT-R3 Dual Element Wing is crafted from prepreg carbon fibre and offers over 277.7 pounds of downforce at 110 mph, making sure weight savings are at their peak.
